   334	/-- The ambient seed-indexed sample space is a direct sample together with a
   335	uniform residue in the selected seed fiber. -/
   336	noncomputable def ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv (L : LdParams) :
   337	    LdSpace L ≃ DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams × Fin (L.q / L.m) where
   338	  toFun z :=
   339	    (⟨z.point, (seedFiberEquiv L z.seed).1, z.direction⟩,
   340	      (seedFiberEquiv L z.seed).2)
   341	  invFun x := ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L x.1 x.2
   342	  left_inv z := by
   343	    funext i
   344	    rcases i with (i | i)
   345	    · rcases i with (i | i)
   346	      · rfl
   347	      · rcases i with ⟨⟩
   348	        change (seedFiberEquiv L).symm (seedFiberEquiv L z.seed) = z.seed
   349	        exact (seedFiberEquiv L).symm_apply_apply z.seed
   350	    · rfl
   351	  right_inv x := by
   352	    rcases x with ⟨sample, residue⟩
   353	    apply Prod.ext
   354	    · cases sample with
   355	      | mk point index direction =>
   356	          simp only [ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_point,
   357	            ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_seed, ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_direction]
   358	          rw [seedFiberEquiv_seedOfIndexResidue]
   359	    · simp [seedOfIndexResidue]

   361	/-- Parsing a canonical seed-indexed question reconstructed from a direct
   362	sample gives exactly the corresponding direct canonical question. -/
   363	theorem parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue (L : LdParams)

   365	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   366	    parseLdQuestion L
   367	        (t, ldCL L t (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue)) =
   368	      (t, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams t sample) := by
   369	  cases t with
   370	  | point =>
   371	    rfl
   372	  | aline =>
   373	      ext <;>
   374	        simp only [parseLdQuestion, ldCL, ldALineCL, directLdMap,
   375	          ldSpaceOfDirectResidue, ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_point, LdSpace.seed,
   376	          chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue]
   377	      congr 1
   378	  | dline =>
   379	      ext <;>
   380	        simp only [parseLdQuestion, ldCL, ldDLineCL, directLdMap,
   381	          ldSpaceOfDirectResidue, ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_point,
   382	          ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_direction, LdSpace.seed,
   383	          LdSpace.direction, chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue,
   384	          prefixProjection]
   385	      rfl

   387	/-- The seed-indexed and direct predicates agree after parsing questions and

   389	theorem ldWinPredicate_parse (L : LdParams)

   391	    directLdWinPredicate L.toDirectLdParams
   392	        (parseLdQuestion L x) (parseLdQuestion L y)
   393	        (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L a) (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L b) =
   394	      ldWinPredicate L x y a b := by
   395	  rcases x with ⟨tx, x⟩

   401	/-- The common source sample is a direct common sample together with its
   402	uniform seed-fiber residue. -/
   403	noncomputable def ldQuestionSeedFiberEquiv (L : LdParams) :
   404	    ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L) ≃
   405	      (((LdType × LdType) × DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) ×
   406	        Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   407	  (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl (LdType × LdType))
   408	    (ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv L)).trans
   409	      (Equiv.prodAssoc (LdType × LdType)
   410	        (DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) (Fin (L.q / L.m))).symm
   411	
   412	/-- Forget the seed residue while retaining the ordered question types and
   413	the directly indexed common sample. -/
   414	noncomputable def ldQuestionSampleProjection (L : LdParams) :
   415	    ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L) →
   416	      (LdType × LdType) × DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams :=
   417	  fun source => (source.1, (ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv L source.2).1)
   418	
   419	/-- Parse both questions in a seed-indexed question pair. -/
   420	noncomputable def parseLdQuestionPair (L : LdParams) :
   421	    (LdQuestion L × LdQuestion L) →
   422	      (DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams ×
   423	        DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams) :=
   424	  fun questions =>
   425	    (parseLdQuestion L questions.1, parseLdQuestion L questions.2)
   426	
   427	private theorem parse_ldQuestionSample (L : LdParams)
   428	    (source : (LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L) :
   429	    parseLdQuestionPair L
   430	        ((source.1.1, ldCL L source.1.1 source.2),
   431	          (source.1.2, ldCL L source.1.2 source.2)) =
   432	      let direct := ldQuestionSampleProjection L source
   433	      ((direct.1.1, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams direct.1.1 direct.2),
   434	        (direct.1.2, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams direct.1.2 direct.2)) := by
   435	  let sample := (ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv L source.2).1
   436	  let residue := (ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv L source.2).2
   437	  have hsource :
   438	      source.2 = ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue := by
   439	    exact (ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv L).symm_apply_apply source.2 |>.symm
   440	  rw [hsource]
   441	  apply Prod.ext
   442	  · exact parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue L source.1.1 sample residue
   443	  · exact parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue L source.1.2 sample residue
   444	
   445	/-- Pushing the seed-indexed question law through the exact parser gives the
   446	directly indexed question law, including the ordered type-pair weights. -/
   447	theorem ldQuestionDistribution_map_parse (L : LdParams) :
   448	    (ldQuestionDistribution L).map (parseLdQuestionPair L) =
   449	      directLdQuestionDistribution L.toDirectLdParams := by
   450	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   451	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   452	  let sourceMap : ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L) →
   453	      LdQuestion L × LdQuestion L := fun source =>
   454	    ((source.1.1, ldCL L source.1.1 source.2),
   455	      (source.1.2, ldCL L source.1.2 source.2))
   456	  let directMap :
   457	      ((LdType × LdType) × DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) →
   458	        DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams ×
   459	          DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams := fun source =>
   460	    ((source.1.1, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams source.1.1 source.2),
   461	      (source.1.2, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams source.1.2 source.2))
   462	  have huniform :
   463	      (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L)).map
   464	          (ldQuestionSampleProjection L) =
   465	        uniformDistribution
   466	          ((LdType × LdType) × DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) := by
   467	    apply uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv (ldQuestionSeedFiberEquiv L)
   468	    intro source
   469	    rfl
   470	  calc
   471	    (ldQuestionDistribution L).map (parseLdQuestionPair L) =
   472	        (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L)).map
   473	          (parseLdQuestionPair L ∘ sourceMap) := by
   474	      exact distribution_map_map_of_isProbability
   475	        (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L))
   476	        (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   477	        sourceMap (parseLdQuestionPair L)
   478	    _ = (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L)).map
   479	        (directMap ∘ ldQuestionSampleProjection L) := by
   480	      congr 1
   481	      funext source
   482	      exact parse_ldQuestionSample L source
   483	    _ = ((uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L)).map
   484	          (ldQuestionSampleProjection L)).map directMap :=
   485	      (distribution_map_map_of_isProbability
   486	        (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L))
   487	        (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   488	        (ldQuestionSampleProjection L) directMap).symm
   489	    _ = directLdQuestionDistribution L.toDirectLdParams := by
   490	      rw [huniform]
   491	      rfl
   492	
   493	end

   620	over the direct index, and the point average may be taken outside. -/
   621	private theorem sum_rev_avgOver_eq
   622	    (F : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ) :
   623	    ∑ j : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution
   624	        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)))
   625	        (fun pv => F pv.1 (Fin.rev j) (directPrefixProjection (Fin.rev j) pv.2)) =

   627	        ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   628	          (fun v => F p i (directPrefixProjection i v)) := by
   629	  rw [avgOver_sum]
   630	  have hrev := Equiv.sum_comp Fin.revPerm (fun i =>
   631	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) fun p =>
   632	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   633	        (fun v => F p i (directPrefixProjection i v)))
   634	  simp only [Fin.revPerm_apply] at hrev
   635	  rw [← hrev]
   636	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
   637	  exact avgOver_uniform_prod (fun p v => F p (Fin.rev j) (directPrefixProjection (Fin.rev j) v))

   648	        ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   649	          (fun v => F p i (directPrefixProjection i v)) := by
   650	  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, Fintype.card_fin, avgOver_sum]
   651	  congr 1

   653	  exact avgOver_uniform_prod (fun p v => F p i (directPrefixProjection i v))

   655	/-- The diagonal-line failure with the line on the left is at most twice the

   657	theorem directCoordinate_diagonal_line_point_le :
   658	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel

   660	      2 * directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.dline, .point) := by
   661	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   662	  unfold ProjStrat.diagonalLineLeftPointRightFailureProbability
   663	  rw [diagonal_line_point_branch_eq, avgOver_index_eq,
   664	    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => diagonal_line_point_term_eq D S hS r j),
   665	    sum_rev_avgOver_eq D (fun p _ v => diagonalLinePointDefect D S hS r p v), one_div]
   666	  have hmain :
   667	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun p =>
   668	          ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   669	            (fun v => diagonalLinePointDefect D S hS r p (directPrefixProjection i v))) ≤
   670	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun p =>
   671	          2 * ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   672	            (fun v => diagonalLinePointRejection D S p i (directPrefixProjection i v))) := by
   673	    refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun p => ?_
   674	    exact diagonal_sum_le D (fun v => diagonalLinePointDefect D S hS r p v)
   675	      (fun i v => diagonalLinePointRejection D S p i v)
   676	      (fun v => qBipartiteConsDefect_nonneg _ _ _)
   677	      (fun i v => directRejectedMass_nonneg D S _ _)
   678	      (fun v => diagonalLinePointDefect_le D S hS r p v)
   679	  rw [avgOver_const_mul] at hmain
   680	  have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
   681	  calc (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ * _ ≤ (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * _) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmain hm
   682	    _ = _ := by ring
   683	
   684	/-- The diagonal-line failure with the point on the left is at most twice the
   685	point/diagonal-line branch rejection of the direct game. -/
   686	theorem directCoordinate_diagonal_point_line_le :
   687	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   688	    (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).diagonalPointLeftLineRightFailureProbability ≤
   689	      2 * directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.point, .dline) := by
   690	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   691	  unfold ProjStrat.diagonalPointLeftLineRightFailureProbability
   692	  rw [diagonal_point_line_branch_eq, avgOver_index_eq,
   693	    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => diagonal_point_line_term_eq D S hS r j),
   694	    sum_rev_avgOver_eq D (fun p _ v => diagonalPointLineDefect D S hS r p v), one_div]
   695	  have hmain :
   696	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun p =>
   697	          ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   698	            (fun v => diagonalPointLineDefect D S hS r p (directPrefixProjection i v))) ≤
   699	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun p =>
   700	          2 * ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   701	            (fun v => diagonalPointLineRejection D S p i (directPrefixProjection i v))) := by
   702	    refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun p => ?_
   703	    exact diagonal_sum_le D (fun v => diagonalPointLineDefect D S hS r p v)
   704	      (fun i v => diagonalPointLineRejection D S p i v)
   705	      (fun v => qBipartiteConsDefect_nonneg _ _ _)
   706	      (fun i v => directRejectedMass_nonneg D S _ _)
   707	      (fun v => diagonalPointLineDefect_le D S hS r p v)
   708	  rw [avgOver_const_mul] at hmain
   709	  have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
   710	  calc (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ * _ ≤ (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * _) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmain hm
   711	    _ = _ := by ring
   712	
   713	end DiagonalBranches

     5	/-!
     6	# Seed-fiber dilation for the directly indexed low-degree game
     7	
     8	This module dilates a seed-indexed low-degree strategy by a maximally
     9	correlated residue register.  Block-diagonal projective measurements retain
    10	arbitrary dependence on the seed within each `chiIndex` fiber.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-458`
    15	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    16	-/
    17	
    18	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
    19	
    20	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    21	
    22	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    23	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	/-! ## Projective block measurements -/
    28	
    29	/-- Relabel a matrix measurement along an equivalence of outcome alphabets. -/
    30	noncomputable def matrixMeasurementTransport
    31	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    32	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    33	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    34	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement beta iota :=
    35	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    36	    (fun b => M.effect (e.symm b))
    37	    (fun b => M.pos (e.symm b))
    38	    (by
    39	      calc
    40	        ∑ b, M.effect (e.symm b) = ∑ a, M.effect a :=
    41	          Equiv.sum_comp e.symm M.effect
    42	        _ = 1 := M.sum_eq_one)
    43	
    44	@[simp] theorem matrixMeasurementTransport_effect
    45	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    46	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    47	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    48	    (b : beta) :
    49	    (matrixMeasurementTransport e M).effect b = M.effect (e.symm b) :=
    50	  rfl
    51	
    52	/-- Relabeling a projective matrix measurement preserves projectivity. -/
    53	theorem matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
    54	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    55	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    56	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    57	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    58	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (matrixMeasurementTransport e M) :=
    59	  fun b => hM (e.symm b)
    60	
    61	/-- Assemble a family of matrix measurements as diagonal blocks indexed by a
    62	finite classical register. -/
    63	noncomputable def blockDiagonalMeasurement
    64	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    65	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    66	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
    67	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    68	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha (iota × block) :=
    69	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    70	    (fun a => Matrix.blockDiagonal fun r => (M r).effect a)
    71	    (fun a => Matrix.blockDiagonal_nonneg
    72	      (fun r => (M r).effect a) (fun r => (M r).pos a))
    73	    (by
    74	      ext ⟨i, r⟩ ⟨j, s⟩
    75	      simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply]
    76	      by_cases hrs : r = s
    77	      · subst s
    78	        simp only [if_pos]
    79	        calc
    80	          ∑ x, (M r).effect x i j = (1 : Matrix iota iota ℂ) i j :=
    81	            by
    82	              simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using
    83	                congrFun (congrFun (M r).sum_eq_one i) j
    84	          _ = (1 : Matrix (iota × block) (iota × block) ℂ)
    85	              (i, r) (j, r) := by
    86	                change (if i = j then 1 else 0) =
    87	                  (if (i, r) = (j, r) then 1 else 0)
    88	                simp
    89	      · simp [hrs])
    90	
    91	@[simp] theorem blockDiagonalMeasurement_effect
    92	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    93	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    94	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
    95	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    96	    (a : alpha) :
    97	    (blockDiagonalMeasurement M).effect a =
    98	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) :=
    99	  rfl
   100	
   101	/-- A block-diagonal family of projective measurements is projective. -/
   102	theorem blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   103	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
   104	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   105	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
   106	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
   107	    (hM : ∀ r, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M r)) :
   108	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (blockDiagonalMeasurement M) := by
   109	  intro a
   110	  constructor
   111	  · change Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) *
   112	        Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) =
   113	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a)
   114	    rw [← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul]
   115	    congr 1
   116	    funext r
   117	    exact (hM r a).isIdempotentElem.eq
   118	  · change (Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a))ᴴ =
   119	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a)
   120	    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal_conjTranspose]
   121	    congr 1
   122	    funext r
   123	    exact (hM r a).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
   124	
   125	/-! ## The correlated residue state -/
   126	
   127	/-- The normalized maximally correlated state on the common seed-fiber
   128	residue. -/
   129	noncomputable def seedResidueAncilla (L : LdParams) :
   130	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
   131	      (Fin (L.q / L.m) × Fin (L.q / L.m)) := by
   132	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   133	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   134	  exact eprState (Fin (L.q / L.m))
   135	
   136	/-- The seed-residue ancilla has unit norm. -/
   137	theorem seedResidueAncilla_norm (L : LdParams) :
   138	    ‖seedResidueAncilla L‖ = 1 := by
   139	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   140	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   141	  exact eprState_norm (Fin (L.q / L.m))
   142	
   143	/-- Reindexing Euclidean coordinates along an equivalence preserves norm. -/
   144	theorem reindexState_norm_eq
   145	    {iota kappa : Type*}
   146	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   147	    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
   148	    (e : iota ≃ kappa) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
   149	    ‖reindexState e psi‖ = ‖psi‖ := by
   150	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
   151	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   152	  change (∑ j : kappa, ‖psi (e.symm j)‖ ^ 2) = ∑ i : iota, ‖psi i‖ ^ 2
   153	  exact e.symm.sum_comp (fun i => ‖psi i‖ ^ 2)
   154	
   155	/-- The coordinate tensor of two Euclidean vectors has the product norm. -/
   156	theorem vecTensor_norm_eq
   157	    {iota kappa : Type*}
   158	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   159	    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
   160	    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ kappa) :
   161	    ‖vecTensor u v‖ = ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ := by
   162	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))]
   163	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, mul_pow, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,
   164	    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   165	  change (∑ p : iota × kappa, ‖u p.1 * v p.2‖ ^ 2) =
   166	    (∑ i : iota, ‖u i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ j : kappa, ‖v j‖ ^ 2
   167	  simp only [norm_mul, mul_pow]
   168	  rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_mul]
   169	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   170	  intro i hi
   171	  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   172	
   173	/-- Tensor the original strategy state with the maximally correlated residue
   174	state and shuffle the factors back into the two local carriers. -/
   175	noncomputable def seedFiberLiftedState
   176	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   177	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
   178	      ((S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)) × (S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :=
   179	  reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor S.ψ (seedResidueAncilla L))
   180	
   181	/-- The correlated seed-fiber lift preserves normalization of the strategy
   182	state. -/
   183	theorem seedFiberLiftedState_norm
   184	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   185	    ‖seedFiberLiftedState S L‖ = 1 := by
   186	  rw [seedFiberLiftedState, reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq,
   187	    S.ψ_norm, seedResidueAncilla_norm, one_mul]
   188	
   189	/-! ## From the seed-indexed game to the direct game -/
   190	
   191	/-- The seed-indexed question selected in one residue block of a direct
   192	question.  Applying `ldCL` ensures that irrelevant ambient coordinates are
   193	canonicalized exactly as in the source game. -/
   194	noncomputable def seededLdQuestion (L : LdParams)
   195	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   196	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : LdQuestion L :=
   197	  (q.1, ldCL L q.1 (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L q.2 residue))
   198	
   199	/-- Dilate a strategy for the seed-indexed low-degree game to the directly
   200	indexed game.  The two local carriers receive correlated copies of the seed
   201	residue, and each measurement is block diagonal in that residue. -/
   202	noncomputable def ldStrategyToDirect (L : LdParams)
   203	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) : Strategy (directLdGame L.toDirectLdParams) where
   204	  ιA := S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)
   205	  ιB := S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m)
   206	  ψ := seedFiberLiftedState S L
   207	  ψ_norm := seedFiberLiftedState_norm S L
   208	  A q := blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
   209	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   210	      (S.A (seededLdQuestion L q residue))
   211	  B q := blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
   212	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   213	      (S.B (seededLdQuestion L q residue))
   214	
   215	/-- Projectivity is preserved by the correlated seed-fiber dilation. -/
   216	theorem ldStrategyToDirect_isProjective (L : LdParams)
   217	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) (hS : S.IsProjective) :
   218	    (ldStrategyToDirect L S).IsProjective := by
   219	  constructor
   220	  · intro q
   221	    apply blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   222	    intro residue
   223	    apply matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
   224	    exact hS.1 (seededLdQuestion L q residue)
   225	  · intro q
   226	    apply blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   227	    intro residue
   228	    apply matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
   229	    exact hS.2 (seededLdQuestion L q residue)
   230	
   231	@[simp] theorem ldStrategyToDirect_A_effect (L : LdParams)
   232	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
   233	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   234	    (answer : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
   235	    ((ldStrategyToDirect L S).A q).effect answer =
   236	      Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
   237	        (S.A (seededLdQuestion L q residue)).effect
   238	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm answer) :=
   239	  rfl
   240	
   241	@[simp] theorem ldStrategyToDirect_B_effect (L : LdParams)
   242	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
   243	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   244	    (answer : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
   245	    ((ldStrategyToDirect L S).B q).effect answer =
   246	      Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
   247	        (S.B (seededLdQuestion L q residue)).effect
   248	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm answer) :=
   249	  rfl
   250	
   251	/-- A direct question reconstructed in a residue block parses back to its
   252	canonical direct form. -/
   253	theorem parse_seededLdQuestion (L : LdParams)
   254	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   255	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   256	    parseLdQuestion L (seededLdQuestion L q residue) =
   257	      (q.1, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams q.1 q.2) := by
   258	  exact parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue L q.1 q.2 residue
   259	
   260	/-- Coordinate formula for the correlated residue lift. -/
   261	theorem seedFiberLiftedState_apply
   262	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
   263	    (i : S.ιA) (j : S.ιB)
   264	    (r s : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   265	    seedFiberLiftedState S L ((i, r), (j, s)) =
   266	      if r = s then
   267	        S.ψ (i, j) * (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹
   268	      else 0 := by
   269	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   270	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   271	  simp [seedFiberLiftedState, reindexState, vecTensor, seedResidueAncilla,
   272	    eprState, prodShuffle]
   273	
   274	end

     3	/-!
     4	# Diagonal branches of the coordinate strategies of the direct low-degree game
     5	
     6	The mature `j`-restricted diagonal sampler decodes to a direct direction with
     7	vanishing prefix below the reversed index `i = Fin.rev j`, and the transported
     8	question of `Transport.Questions` carries the leading index of that direction.
     9	On the generic event that the direction is nonzero at `i`, the leading index
    10	is `i` and the question is the canonical direct question of the direct sample
    11	`(p, i, v)`, where the mature defect is bounded by the direct rejection.
    12	Otherwise the restricted direction is also the restriction at the next index,
    13	so the mature quantity recurses to that index with the factor `q⁻¹`, the
    14	probability that the sampled coordinate vanishes; at the last index the zero
    15	direction has the last coordinate as its leading index by convention and no
    16	recursion occurs.  Summing the recursion shows that each mature diagonal
    17	branch is at most `q / (q - 1) ≤ 2` times the corresponding branch rejection
    18	of the direct game.  The factor is genuine: a strategy that answers the
    19	canonical question of a direction badly and the non-canonical questions of the
    20	same geometric line well has mature diagonal failure exceeding the direct
    21	branch rejection.
    22	
    23	## References
    24	
    25	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:214-458`
    26	- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-65,130-151`
    27	- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-121`
    28	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    29	-/
    30	
    31	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
    32	
    33	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    34	
    35	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    36	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-! ## Direction coordinates and the one-coordinate recursion
    41	
    42	The mature `j`-restricted diagonal sampler decodes to a direct direction with
    43	vanishing prefix below the reversed index `i = Fin.rev j`, and the transported
    44	question carries the leading index of that direction.  On the generic event
    45	that the direction is nonzero at `i`, the leading index is `i` and the
    46	question is the canonical direct question of the direct sample `(p, i, v)`.
    47	Otherwise the restricted direction is also the restriction at the next index,
    48	so the mature quantity recurses with the factor `q⁻¹`, the probability that
    49	the sampled coordinate vanishes.  At the last index the zero direction has the
    50	last coordinate as its leading index by convention, and no recursion occurs. -/
    51	
    52	section DirectionCoordinates
    53	
    54	variable (D : DirectLdParams)
    55	
    56	/-- Restricting at an index where the direction vanishes is restricting at the
    57	next index. -/
    58	private theorem directPrefixProjection_succ_of_zero
    59	    (i i' : Fin D.m) (hi : i'.val = i.val + 1)
    60	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (hv : v i = 0) :
    61	    directPrefixProjection i v = directPrefixProjection i' v := by
    62	  funext j
    63	  unfold directPrefixProjection
    64	  by_cases hj : j.val < i.val
    65	  · rw [if_pos hj, if_pos (by omega)]
    66	  · by_cases hj' : j.val < i'.val
    67	    · rw [if_neg hj, if_pos hj']
    68	      have hji : j = i := Fin.ext (by omega)
    69	      rw [hji, hv]
    70	    · rw [if_neg hj, if_neg hj']
    71	
    72	/-- Restriction beyond a coordinate ignores translation along that
    73	coordinate. -/
    74	private theorem directPrefixProjection_add_single
    75	    (i i' : Fin D.m) (hi : i.val < i'.val)
    76	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (c : DirectScalarQ D) :
    77	    directPrefixProjection i' (v + c • Pi.single i (1 : DirectScalarQ D)) =
    78	      directPrefixProjection i' v := by
    79	  funext j
    80	  unfold directPrefixProjection
    81	  by_cases hj : j.val < i'.val
    82	  · rw [if_pos hj, if_pos hj]
    83	  · rw [if_neg hj, if_neg hj]
    84	    have hji : j ≠ i := by
    85	      intro h
    86	      apply hj
    87	      rw [h]
    88	      exact hi
    89	    simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hji]
    90	
    91	/-- At the last coordinate the restricted direction has that coordinate as
    92	its leading index: either the direction is nonzero there, or the restricted
    93	direction is zero and the leading index of the zero direction is the last
    94	coordinate by convention. -/
    95	private theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection_last
    96	    (i : Fin D.m) (hi : i.val + 1 = D.m) (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
    97	    directDiagonalIndexOf D (directPrefixProjection i v) = i := by
    98	  by_cases hv : v i = 0
    99	  · have hzero : directPrefixProjection i v = 0 := by
   100	      funext j
   101	      unfold directPrefixProjection
   102	      by_cases hj : j.val < i.val
   103	      · rw [if_pos hj]
   104	        rfl
   105	      · rw [if_neg hj]
   106	        have hji : j = i := Fin.ext (by have := j.isLt; omega)
   107	        rw [hji, hv]
   108	        rfl
   109	    rw [hzero]

   121	/-- Restricting to the vanishing of a coordinate below the restriction index
   122	scales the uniform average by the inverse field size: translation along that
   123	coordinate permutes the directions and preserves the restriction. -/
   124	private theorem avgOver_uniform_coord_zero (i i' : Fin D.m) (hi : i.val < i'.val)
   125	    (G : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ) :
   126	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   127	        (fun v => if v i = 0 then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0) =
   128	      (Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
   129	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   130	          (fun v => G (directPrefixProjection i' v)) := by
   131	  classical
   132	  have hshift : ∀ c : DirectScalarQ D,
   133	      (∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   134	        if v i = c then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0) =
   135	      ∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   136	        if v i = 0 then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0 := by
   137	    intro c
   138	    refine Fintype.sum_equiv
   139	      (Equiv.addRight ((-c) • Pi.single i (1 : DirectScalarQ D))) _ _ ?_
   140	    intro v
   141	    rw [Equiv.coe_addRight, directPrefixProjection_add_single D i i' hi]
   142	    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
   143	      add_neg_eq_zero]
   144	  have hsum : (∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D, G (directPrefixProjection i' v)) =
   145	      (Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ) *
   146	        ∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   147	          if v i = 0 then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0 := by
   148	    calc
   149	      (∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D, G (directPrefixProjection i' v)) =
   150	          ∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D, ∑ c : DirectScalarQ D,
   151	            if v i = c then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0 := by
   152	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => ?_
   153	        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
   154	        simp
   155	      _ = ∑ c : DirectScalarQ D, ∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   156	            if v i = c then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0 :=
   157	        Finset.sum_comm
   158	      _ = ∑ c : DirectScalarQ D, ∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   159	            if v i = 0 then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0 :=
   160	        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => hshift c
   161	      _ = _ := by
   162	        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]

   164	    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
   165	  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, hsum,
   166	    mul_left_comm, ← mul_assoc ((Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ)⁻¹)
   167	      (Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ), inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, one_mul]

   169	/-- Split a direct direction into the mature free coordinates of the
   170	`j`-restricted diagonal test, read in reversed coordinate order, and the
   171	coordinates below the reversed index. -/
   172	private def restrictedDirectionEquiv (j : Fin D.m) :
   173	    (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ≃
   174	      (Fin (j.val + 1) → Fq D.toLDTParameters) ×
   175	        (Fin (Fin.rev j).val → DirectScalarQ D) where
   176	  toFun v :=
   177	    (fun c => directScalarEquiv D (v ⟨D.m - 1 - c.val, by have := D.hm; omega⟩),
   178	      fun c => v ⟨c.val, by
   179	        have h1 := c.isLt
   180	        have h2 := Fin.val_rev j
   181	        omega⟩)
   182	  invFun x := fun c =>
   183	    if h : c.val < (Fin.rev j).val then x.2 ⟨c.val, h⟩
   184	    else (directScalarEquiv D).symm
   185	      (x.1 ⟨D.m - 1 - c.val, by
   186	        have h1 := c.isLt
   187	        have h2 := j.isLt
   188	        have h3 := Fin.val_rev j
   189	        omega⟩)
   190	  left_inv v := by
   191	    funext c
   192	    by_cases h : c.val < (Fin.rev j).val
   193	    · simp only [dif_pos h, Fin.eta]
   194	    · simp only [dif_neg h, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
   195	      refine congrArg v (Fin.ext ?_)
   196	      change D.m - 1 - (D.m - 1 - c.val) = c.val
   197	      have h1 := c.isLt
   198	      have h2 := D.hm
   199	      omega
   200	  right_inv x := by
   201	    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
   202	    · funext c
   203	      have h1 := c.isLt
   204	      have h2 := j.isLt
   205	      have h3 := Fin.val_rev j
   206	      have hc : ¬ (D.m - 1 - c.val < (Fin.rev j).val) := by omega
   207	      simp only [dif_neg hc, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   208	      refine congrArg x.1 (Fin.ext ?_)
   209	      change D.m - 1 - (D.m - 1 - c.val) = c.val
   210	      omega
   211	    · funext c
   212	      simp only [dif_pos c.isLt, Fin.eta]

   217	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   218	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   219	    ldtPointToDirect D
   220	        (extendRestrictedDirection j (restrictedDirectionEquiv D j v).1) =
   221	      directPrefixProjection (Fin.rev j) v := by

   226	    unfold directPrefixProjection
   227	    rw [if_pos hc]

   229	    have hrevc := Fin.val_rev c
   230	    have hcm := c.isLt
   231	    have hle : (Fin.rev c).val ≤ j.val := by omega
   232	    unfold directPrefixProjection

   241	/-- Averaging over the mature `j`-restricted diagonal sample is averaging over
   242	a direct point and a direct direction restricted at the reversed index. -/
   243	private theorem avgOver_restrictedDiagonalSample_eq (j : Fin D.m)
   244	    (H : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ) :
   245	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel

   271	/-- Geometric-series bookkeeping for the one-coordinate recursion.  If every
   272	term is at most its rejection term plus `q⁻¹` times the term at the next
   273	index, and the term at the last index is at most its rejection term, then the
   274	sum is at most twice the sum of the rejection terms once `q ≥ 2`. -/
   275	private theorem sum_le_two_mul_sum_of_recursion {m : ℕ} (t r : Fin m → ℝ) (q : ℝ)
   276	    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (ht : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i)
   277	    (hstep : ∀ i i' : Fin m, i'.val = i.val + 1 → t i ≤ r i + q⁻¹ * t i')
   278	    (hlast : ∀ i : Fin m, i.val + 1 = m → t i ≤ r i) :
   279	    ∑ i, t i ≤ 2 * ∑ i, r i := by
   280	  classical
   281	  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by linarith
   282	  have hqinv : q⁻¹ ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) hq
   283	  have hqinv0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le
   284	  let succSum : Fin m → ℝ := fun i =>
   285	    ∑ i' : Fin m, if i'.val = i.val + 1 then t i' else 0
   286	  have hbound : ∀ i, t i ≤ r i + q⁻¹ * succSum i := by
   287	    intro i
   288	    by_cases h : i.val + 1 < m
   289	    · have hsucc : succSum i = t ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ := by
   290	        simp only [succSum]
   291	        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩]
   292	        · simp
   293	        · intro b _ hb
   294	          rw [if_neg]
   295	          intro hb'
   296	          exact hb (Fin.ext hb')
   297	        · intro habs
   298	          exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) habs
   299	      rw [hsucc]
   300	      exact hstep i ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ rfl
   301	    · have hlast' : i.val + 1 = m := by
   302	        have := i.isLt
   303	        omega
   304	      have hsucc : succSum i = 0 := by
   305	        simp only [succSum]
   306	        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i' _ => ?_
   307	        rw [if_neg]
   308	        intro h'
   309	        have := i'.isLt
   310	        omega
   311	      rw [hsucc, mul_zero, add_zero]
   312	      exact hlast i hlast'
   313	  have hsuccSum : ∑ i, succSum i ≤ ∑ i, t i := by
   314	    simp only [succSum]
   315	    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   316	    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i' _ => ?_
   317	    rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
   318	    have hcard :
   319	        ((Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin m => i'.val = i.val + 1).card : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
   320	      have h1 : (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin m => i'.val = i.val + 1).card ≤ 1 := by
   321	        rw [Finset.card_le_one]
   322	        intro a ha b hb
   323	        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at ha hb
   324	        exact Fin.ext (by omega)
   325	      exact_mod_cast h1
   326	    calc ((Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin m => i'.val = i.val + 1).card : ℝ) * t i'
   327	        ≤ 1 * t i' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (ht i')
   328	      _ = t i' := one_mul _
   329	  have htotal : ∑ i, t i ≤ ∑ i, r i + q⁻¹ * ∑ i, t i := by
   330	    calc ∑ i, t i ≤ ∑ i, (r i + q⁻¹ * succSum i) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hbound i
   331	      _ = ∑ i, r i + q⁻¹ * ∑ i, succSum i := by
   332	        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
   333	      _ ≤ ∑ i, r i + q⁻¹ * ∑ i, t i := by
   334	        linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsuccSum hqinv0]
   335	  have hT : 0 ≤ ∑ i, t i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => ht i
   336	  have hhalf : q⁻¹ * ∑ i, t i ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, t i :=
   337	    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqinv hT
   338	  linarith

   344	/-- One step of the recursion at a fixed point.  On the generic event the
   345	leading index is the sampled index and the mature defect is bounded by the
   346	direct rejection there; on the vanishing event the restriction agrees with the
   347	restriction at the next index. -/
   348	private theorem diagonal_recursion_step
   349	    (dd : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   350	    (rj : Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   351	    (hrj : ∀ i v, 0 ≤ rj i v)
   352	    (hdd : ∀ v, dd v ≤ rj (directDiagonalIndexOf D v) v)
   353	    (i i' : Fin D.m) (hi : i'.val = i.val + 1) :
   354	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   355	        (fun v => dd (directPrefixProjection i v)) ≤
   356	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   357	          (fun v => rj i (directPrefixProjection i v)) +
   358	        (Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
   359	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   360	            (fun v => dd (directPrefixProjection i' v)) := by
   361	  classical
   362	  have hsplit : ∀ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   363	      dd (directPrefixProjection i v) =
   364	        (if v i = 0 then 0 else dd (directPrefixProjection i v)) +
   365	          (if v i = 0 then dd (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0) := by
   366	    intro v
   367	    by_cases hv : v i = 0
   368	    · rw [if_pos hv, if_pos hv, zero_add,
   369	        directPrefixProjection_succ_of_zero D i i' hi v hv]
   370	    · rw [if_neg hv, if_neg hv, add_zero]
   371	  rw [avgOver_congr _ _ _ hsplit, avgOver_add,
   372	    avgOver_uniform_coord_zero D i i' (by omega) dd]
   373	  refine add_le_add ?_ le_rfl
   374	  refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun v => ?_
   375	  by_cases hv : v i = 0
   376	  · rw [if_pos hv]
   377	    exact hrj i _
   378	  · rw [if_neg hv]
   379	    calc dd (directPrefixProjection i v) ≤
   380	        rj (directDiagonalIndexOf D (directPrefixProjection i v))
   381	          (directPrefixProjection i v) := hdd _
   382	      _ = rj i (directPrefixProjection i v) := by
   383	        rw [directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection D i v hv]
   384	
   385	/-- At the last index the mature defect is bounded by the direct rejection
   386	without recursion. -/
   387	private theorem diagonal_recursion_last
   388	    (dd : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   389	    (rj : Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   390	    (hdd : ∀ v, dd v ≤ rj (directDiagonalIndexOf D v) v)
   391	    (i : Fin D.m) (hi : i.val + 1 = D.m) :
   392	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   393	        (fun v => dd (directPrefixProjection i v)) ≤
   394	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   395	        (fun v => rj i (directPrefixProjection i v)) := by
   396	  refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun v => ?_
   397	  calc dd (directPrefixProjection i v) ≤
   398	      rj (directDiagonalIndexOf D (directPrefixProjection i v))
   399	        (directPrefixProjection i v) := hdd _
   400	    _ = rj i (directPrefixProjection i v) := by
   401	      rw [directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection_last D i hi v]
   402	
   403	/-- Summed over the restriction index, the mature diagonal quantities at a
   404	fixed point are at most twice the direct rejections. -/
   405	private theorem diagonal_sum_le
   406	    (dd : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   407	    (rj : Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   408	    (hdd0 : ∀ v, 0 ≤ dd v) (hrj : ∀ i v, 0 ≤ rj i v)
   409	    (hdd : ∀ v, dd v ≤ rj (directDiagonalIndexOf D v) v) :
   410	    ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   411	        (fun v => dd (directPrefixProjection i v)) ≤
   412	      2 * ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   413	        (fun v => rj i (directPrefixProjection i v)) := by
   414	  have hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) := Fintype.one_lt_card
   415	  refine sum_le_two_mul_sum_of_recursion _ _ (Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ)
   416	    (by exact_mod_cast hcard) ?_ ?_ ?_
   417	  · intro i
   418	    exact avgOver_nonneg _ _ fun v => hdd0 _
   419	  · intro i i' hi
   420	    exact diagonal_recursion_step D dd rj hrj hdd i i' hi
   421	  · intro i hi
   422	    exact diagonal_recursion_last D dd rj hdd i hi
   423	
   424	end DiagonalRecursion

    25	/-- Quantum soundness obligation for the directly indexed low-degree game.
    26	This is the repaired import form proposed in

    34	as a hypothesis here. -/
    35	theorem exists_direct_ld_soundness :
    36	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
    37	      ∀ (D : DirectLdParams) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
    38	        ∀ S : Strategy (directLdGame D), S.IsProjective → 1 - ε ≤ S.value →
    39	          ∃ GA : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιA,
    40	            ∃ GB : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιB,
    41	              consistencyDefect
    42	                  (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
    43	                  (fun u outcome =>
    44	                    heteroKron
    45	                      (((S.A (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
    46	                        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome) 1)
    47	                  (fun u outcome =>
    48	                    heteroKron 1
    49	                      ((GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
    50	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k ∧
    51	              consistencyDefect
    52	                  (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
    53	                  (fun u outcome =>
    54	                    heteroKron
    55	                      ((GA.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) 1)
    56	                  (fun u outcome =>
    57	                    heteroKron 1
    58	                      (((S.B (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
    59	                        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome))
    60	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k ∧
    61	              consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
    62	                  (fun _ g => heteroKron (GA.effect g) 1)
    63	                  (fun _ g => heteroKron 1 (GB.effect g))
    64	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k := by

blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:121:	The source states the two line-versus-point clauses with ``the'' $t \in \F_q$ such that $x_{\overline w} = u_0 + t v$. When the direction is nonzero and $x_{\overline w}$ lies on the line, exactly one such $t$ exists and the formulation above agrees with the source. But zero directions occur: Definition~\ref{def:line} explicitly permits them, and the question distribution of Definition~\ref{def:ld-question-distribution} produces $\mathsf{DLine}$ questions with $v' = \pi_{i-1}(v) = 0$ with positive probability, namely whenever the last $m - i + 1$ coordinates of $v$ vanish. In that case $\ell(u_0, 0) = \{u_0\}$, every $t \in \F_q$ satisfies $x_{\overline w} = u_0 + t v'$ when $x_{\overline w} = u_0$, and the source clause does not determine acceptance for a nonconstant answer polynomial. The universal quantification over $t$ adopted in Definition~\ref{def:ld-win-predicate} makes the predicate a well-defined function of its arguments; it accepts vacuously when no such $t$ exists, a case the question distribution never produces. Completeness is unaffected: the restriction of a polynomial $g$ to the singleton line $\ell(u_0,0)$, expressed through the parameterization $t \mapsto u_0 + t \cdot 0$, is the constant polynomial with value $g(u_0)$, which passes the check for every $t$. Soundness is likewise unaffected: zero directions occur with probability at most $2/(mq)$, so any acceptance convention on this event changes success probabilities by at most that amount; the game-correspondence obligation enumerated in the proof of Theorem~\ref{lem:ld-soundness} accounts for this event explicitly, and an error of this shape is absorbed into the universal constants of $\delta_{\mathrm{ld}}$.

/-! ## Parameters and finite-field coordinates -/

/-- Regard direct-game parameters as parameters of the mature LDT interface.
The field size, dimension, and degree are unchanged. -/
@[reducible] def DirectLdParams.toLDTParameters (D : DirectLdParams) : Parameters where
  m := D.m
  q := D.q
  d := D.d
  hm := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one D.hm
  hq := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := D.hq
    rw [hq]
    exact Nat.pow_pos (by decide)
  hqPrimePower := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := D.hq
    exact ⟨2, n, Nat.prime_two, hn.pos, hq⟩

/-- The fixed QPBT field model, viewed as the model used by the mature LDT
interface. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def DirectLdParams.toLDTFieldModel (D : DirectLdParams) :
    FieldModel D.toLDTParameters.q :=
  D.model.toFieldModel

/-- Coordinate coding from the direct scalar field to the mature LDT carrier. -/
noncomputable def directScalarEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
    DirectScalarQ D ≃ Fq D.toLDTParameters :=
  binaryRepresentation D.model

/-- Coordinate coding identifies direct points with mature LDT points, with
the coordinate order reversed: direct coordinate `j` is mature coordinate
`Fin.rev j`.  The direct game zeroes a *prefix* of a sampled diagonal
direction (`directPrefixProjection`, paper equation `eq:cl-dlnf`), whereas
the mature test zeroes a *suffix* (`extendRestrictedDirection`,
`references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-65`).  Reversing the coordinate
order aligns the two restriction conventions, as required by the game
correspondence in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`. -/
noncomputable def directPointEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
    (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ≃ Point D.toLDTParameters where
  toFun u i := directScalarEquiv D (u (Fin.rev i))
  invFun u j := (directScalarEquiv D).symm (u (Fin.rev j))
  left_inv u := by
    funext j
    simp
  right_inv u := by
    funext i
    simp

@[simp] theorem directPointEquiv_apply (D : DirectLdParams)
    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (i : Fin D.m) :
    directPointEquiv D u i = directScalarEquiv D (u (Fin.rev i)) :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem directPointEquiv_symm_apply (D : DirectLdParams)
    (u : Point D.toLDTParameters) (j : Fin D.m) :
    (directPointEquiv D).symm u j =
      (directScalarEquiv D).symm (u (Fin.rev j)) :=
  rfl

+/-!
+# Branch comparison for the coordinate strategies of the direct low-degree game
+
+Every branch of the mature low individual degree failure probability of a
+coordinate strategy `directCoordinateProjStrat` is compared with the ordered
+type-pair branch of the direct game asking the same questions.  An accepted
+direct answer pair reads out to equal mature answers: the line answer, rebased
+to the mature line and evaluated at the mature base point, is the point
+answer, and the zero-direction convention reads the constant value at the base
+point.  Hence the mature inconsistency mass at a question pair is at most the
+rejected direct Born mass there.  The point-agreement and axis-line branches
+then compare exactly after the coordinate reindexing of `directPointEquiv`;
+the diagonal branches are treated in `Transport.DiagonalRecursion`.
+

+- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:214-458`
+- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:130-151`
+- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-121,139-166`
+- `MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/StrategyFailures.lean:18-130`
+- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`

+/-- The Born mass of the rejected answer pairs at a fixed pair of direct
+questions.  Its uniform average over the common direct sample of an ordered
+type pair is `directLdBranchRejectionProbability`. -/
+def directRejectedMass (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
+    (x y : DirectLdQuestion D) : ℝ :=
+  ∑ a : DirectLdAnswer D, ∑ b : DirectLdAnswer D,
+    if directLdWinPredicate D x y a b then 0 else outcomeWeight S x y a b
+
+theorem directRejectedMass_nonneg (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (x y : DirectLdQuestion D) :
+    0 ≤ directRejectedMass D S x y := by
+  refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => ?_
+  split_ifs
+  · exact le_rfl
+  · exact outcomeWeight_nonneg S x y a b
+
+/-- The branch rejection probability of an ordered type pair is the uniform
+average of the rejected Born mass at the canonical questions of the common
+direct sample. -/
+theorem directLdBranchRejectionProbability_eq_avgOver (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (types : LdType × LdType) :
+    directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S types =
+      avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D)) fun sample =>
+        directRejectedMass D S
+          (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
+          (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) :=
+  rfl

   144	  have hsum : (∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D, G (directPrefixProjection i' v)) =
   145	      (Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ) *
   146	        ∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   147	          if v i = 0 then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0 := by
   148	    calc
   149	      (∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D, G (directPrefixProjection i' v)) =
   150	          ∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D, ∑ c : DirectScalarQ D,
   151	            if v i = c then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0 := by
   152	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => ?_
   153	        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
   154	        simp
   155	      _ = ∑ c : DirectScalarQ D, ∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   156	            if v i = c then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0 :=
   157	        Finset.sum_comm
   158	      _ = ∑ c : DirectScalarQ D, ∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   159	            if v i = 0 then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0 :=
   160	        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => hshift c
   161	      _ = _ := by
   162	        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
   163	  have hq : (Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
   164	    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
   165	  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, hsum,
   166	    mul_left_comm, ← mul_assoc ((Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ)⁻¹)
   167	      (Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ), inv_mul_cancel₀ hq, one_mul]

   169	/-- Split a direct direction into the mature free coordinates of the
   170	`j`-restricted diagonal test, read in reversed coordinate order, and the
   171	coordinates below the reversed index. -/
   172	private def restrictedDirectionEquiv (j : Fin D.m) :
   173	    (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ≃
   174	      (Fin (j.val + 1) → Fq D.toLDTParameters) ×
   175	        (Fin (Fin.rev j).val → DirectScalarQ D) where
   176	  toFun v :=
   177	    (fun c => directScalarEquiv D (v ⟨D.m - 1 - c.val, by have := D.hm; omega⟩),
   178	      fun c => v ⟨c.val, by
   179	        have h1 := c.isLt
   180	        have h2 := Fin.val_rev j

180	        have h2 := Fin.val_rev j
   181	        omega⟩)
   182	  invFun x := fun c =>
   183	    if h : c.val < (Fin.rev j).val then x.2 ⟨c.val, h⟩
   184	    else (directScalarEquiv D).symm
   185	      (x.1 ⟨D.m - 1 - c.val, by
   186	        have h1 := c.isLt
   187	        have h2 := j.isLt
   188	        have h3 := Fin.val_rev j
   189	        omega⟩)
   190	  left_inv v := by
   191	    funext c
   192	    by_cases h : c.val < (Fin.rev j).val
   193	    · simp only [dif_pos h, Fin.eta]
   194	    · simp only [dif_neg h, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
   195	      refine congrArg v (Fin.ext ?_)
   196	      change D.m - 1 - (D.m - 1 - c.val) = c.val
   197	      have h1 := c.isLt
   198	      have h2 := D.hm
   199	      omega
   200	  right_inv x := by
   201	    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
   202	    · funext c
   203	      have h1 := c.isLt
   204	      have h2 := j.isLt
   205	      have h3 := Fin.val_rev j
   206	      have hc : ¬ (D.m - 1 - c.val < (Fin.rev j).val) := by omega
   207	      simp only [dif_neg hc, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   208	      refine congrArg x.1 (Fin.ext ?_)
   209	      change D.m - 1 - (D.m - 1 - c.val) = c.val
   210	      omega
   211	    · funext c
   212	      simp only [dif_pos c.isLt, Fin.eta]

   214	/-- The decoded `j`-restricted mature direction of the free coordinates is the
   215	restriction of the direction at the reversed index. -/
   216	private theorem ldtPointToDirect_extend_restrictedDirectionEquiv (j : Fin D.m)
   217	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   218	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   219	    ldtPointToDirect D
   220	        (extendRestrictedDirection j (restrictedDirectionEquiv D j v).1) =
   221	      directPrefixProjection (Fin.rev j) v := by
   222	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   223	  funext c

   226	    unfold directPrefixProjection

   229	    have hrevc := Fin.val_rev c
   230	    have hcm := c.isLt
   231	    have hle : (Fin.rev c).val ≤ j.val := by omega
   232	    unfold directPrefixProjection

   235	      dif_pos hle, restrictedDirectionEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
   236	    refine congrArg v (Fin.ext ?_)
   237	    change D.m - 1 - (Fin.rev c).val = c.val

   241	/-- Averaging over the mature `j`-restricted diagonal sample is averaging over
   242	a direct point and a direct direction restricted at the reversed index. -/
   243	private theorem avgOver_restrictedDiagonalSample_eq (j : Fin D.m)
   244	    (H : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ) :
   245	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   246	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (RestrictedDiagonalSample D.toLDTParameters j))

   248	          (ldtPointToDirect D (extendRestrictedDirection j s.2))) =

   250	          ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)))
   251	        (fun pv => H pv.1 (directPrefixProjection (Fin.rev j) pv.2)) := by
   252	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel

   254	      (ldtPointToDirect D (extendRestrictedDirection j free))),

   256	    avgOver_uniform_equiv (directPointEquiv D)]
   257	  apply avgOver_congr

   260	    (fun free => H (ldtPointToDirect D u)
   261	      (ldtPointToDirect D (extendRestrictedDirection j free)))]
   262	  apply avgOver_congr

   265	      (ldtPointToDirect D (extendRestrictedDirection j (restrictedDirectionEquiv D j v).1)) =

   271	/-- Geometric-series bookkeeping for the one-coordinate recursion.  If every
   272	term is at most its rejection term plus `q⁻¹` times the term at the next
   273	index, and the term at the last index is at most its rejection term, then the
   274	sum is at most twice the sum of the rejection terms once `q ≥ 2`. -/
   275	private theorem sum_le_two_mul_sum_of_recursion {m : ℕ} (t r : Fin m → ℝ) (q : ℝ)
   276	    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (ht : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i)
   277	    (hstep : ∀ i i' : Fin m, i'.val = i.val + 1 → t i ≤ r i + q⁻¹ * t i')
   278	    (hlast : ∀ i : Fin m, i.val + 1 = m → t i ≤ r i) :
   279	    ∑ i, t i ≤ 2 * ∑ i, r i := by
   280	  classical
   281	  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by linarith
   282	  have hqinv : q⁻¹ ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) hq
   283	  have hqinv0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le
   284	  let succSum : Fin m → ℝ := fun i =>
   285	    ∑ i' : Fin m, if i'.val = i.val + 1 then t i' else 0
   286	  have hbound : ∀ i, t i ≤ r i + q⁻¹ * succSum i := by
   287	    intro i
   288	    by_cases h : i.val + 1 < m
   289	    · have hsucc : succSum i = t ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ := by
   290	        simp only [succSum]
   291	        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩]
   292	        · simp
   293	        · intro b _ hb
   294	          rw [if_neg]
   295	          intro hb'
   296	          exact hb (Fin.ext hb')
   297	        · intro habs
   298	          exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) habs
   299	      rw [hsucc]
   300	      exact hstep i ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ rfl
   301	    · have hlast' : i.val + 1 = m := by
   302	        have := i.isLt
   303	        omega
   304	      have hsucc : succSum i = 0 := by
   305	        simp only [succSum]
   306	        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i' _ => ?_
   307	        rw [if_neg]
   308	        intro h'
   309	        have := i'.isLt
   310	        omega
   311	      rw [hsucc, mul_zero, add_zero]
   312	      exact hlast i hlast'
   313	  have hsuccSum : ∑ i, succSum i ≤ ∑ i, t i := by
   314	    simp only [succSum]
   315	    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   316	    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i' _ => ?_
   317	    rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
   318	    have hcard :
   319	        ((Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin m => i'.val = i.val + 1).card : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
   320	      have h1 : (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin m => i'.val = i.val + 1).card ≤ 1 := by
   321	        rw [Finset.card_le_one]
   322	        intro a ha b hb
   323	        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at ha hb
   324	        exact Fin.ext (by omega)
   325	      exact_mod_cast h1
   326	    calc ((Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin m => i'.val = i.val + 1).card : ℝ) * t i'
   327	        ≤ 1 * t i' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (ht i')
   328	      _ = t i' := one_mul _
   329	  have htotal : ∑ i, t i ≤ ∑ i, r i + q⁻¹ * ∑ i, t i := by
   330	    calc ∑ i, t i ≤ ∑ i, (r i + q⁻¹ * succSum i) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hbound i
   331	      _ = ∑ i, r i + q⁻¹ * ∑ i, succSum i := by
   332	        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
   333	      _ ≤ ∑ i, r i + q⁻¹ * ∑ i, t i := by
   334	        linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsuccSum hqinv0]
   335	  have hT : 0 ≤ ∑ i, t i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => ht i
   336	  have hhalf : q⁻¹ * ∑ i, t i ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, t i :=
   337	    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqinv hT
   338	  linarith

   344	/-- One step of the recursion at a fixed point.  On the generic event the
   345	leading index is the sampled index and the mature defect is bounded by the
   346	direct rejection there; on the vanishing event the restriction agrees with the
   347	restriction at the next index. -/
   348	private theorem diagonal_recursion_step
   349	    (dd : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   350	    (rj : Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   351	    (hrj : ∀ i v, 0 ≤ rj i v)
   352	    (hdd : ∀ v, dd v ≤ rj (directDiagonalIndexOf D v) v)
   353	    (i i' : Fin D.m) (hi : i'.val = i.val + 1) :
   354	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   355	        (fun v => dd (directPrefixProjection i v)) ≤
   356	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   357	          (fun v => rj i (directPrefixProjection i v)) +
   358	        (Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
   359	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   360	            (fun v => dd (directPrefixProjection i' v)) := by
   361	  classical
   362	  have hsplit : ∀ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   363	      dd (directPrefixProjection i v) =
   364	        (if v i = 0 then 0 else dd (directPrefixProjection i v)) +
   365	          (if v i = 0 then dd (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0) := by

   619	/-- Summing a decoded diagonal quantity over the reversed index is summing it
   620	over the direct index, and the point average may be taken outside. -/
   621	private theorem sum_rev_avgOver_eq
   622	    (F : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ) :

   624	        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)))

   631	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) fun p =>
   632	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   633	        (fun v => F p i (directPrefixProjection i v)))

   635	  rw [← hrev]
   636	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_

   655	/-- The diagonal-line failure with the line on the left is at most twice the
   656	diagonal-line/point branch rejection of the direct game. -/
   657	theorem directCoordinate_diagonal_line_point_le :
   658	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   659	    (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).diagonalLineLeftPointRightFailureProbability ≤
   660	      2 * directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.dline, .point) := by
   661	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   662	  unfold ProjStrat.diagonalLineLeftPointRightFailureProbability
   663	  rw [diagonal_line_point_branch_eq, avgOver_index_eq,
   664	    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => diagonal_line_point_term_eq D S hS r j),
   665	    sum_rev_avgOver_eq D (fun p _ v => diagonalLinePointDefect D S hS r p v), one_div]
   666	  have hmain :
   667	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun p =>
   668	          ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   669	            (fun v => diagonalLinePointDefect D S hS r p (directPrefixProjection i v))) ≤
   670	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun p =>
   671	          2 * ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   672	            (fun v => diagonalLinePointRejection D S p i (directPrefixProjection i v))) := by
   673	    refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun p => ?_
   674	    exact diagonal_sum_le D (fun v => diagonalLinePointDefect D S hS r p v)
   675	      (fun i v => diagonalLinePointRejection D S p i v)
   676	      (fun v => qBipartiteConsDefect_nonneg _ _ _)
   677	      (fun i v => directRejectedMass_nonneg D S _ _)
   678	      (fun v => diagonalLinePointDefect_le D S hS r p v)
   679	  rw [avgOver_const_mul] at hmain
   680	  have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
   681	  calc (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ * _ ≤ (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * _) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmain hm
   682	    _ = _ := by ring

   148	    (e : iota ≃ kappa) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
   149	    ‖reindexState e psi‖ = ‖psi‖ := by
   150	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
   151	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   152	  change (∑ j : kappa, ‖psi (e.symm j)‖ ^ 2) = ∑ i : iota, ‖psi i‖ ^ 2
   153	  exact e.symm.sum_comp (fun i => ‖psi i‖ ^ 2)
   154	
   155	/-- The coordinate tensor of two Euclidean vectors has the product norm. -/
   156	theorem vecTensor_norm_eq
   157	    {iota kappa : Type*}
   158	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   159	    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
   160	    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ kappa) :
   161	    ‖vecTensor u v‖ = ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ := by
   162	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))]
   163	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, mul_pow, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,
   164	    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   165	  change (∑ p : iota × kappa, ‖u p.1 * v p.2‖ ^ 2) =
   166	    (∑ i : iota, ‖u i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ j : kappa, ‖v j‖ ^ 2
   167	  simp only [norm_mul, mul_pow]
   168	  rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_mul]
   169	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   170	  intro i hi
   171	  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   172	
   173	/-- Tensor the original strategy state with the maximally correlated residue
   174	state and shuffle the factors back into the two local carriers. -/
   175	noncomputable def seedFiberLiftedState
   176	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   177	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
   178	      ((S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)) × (S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :=
   179	  reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor S.ψ (seedResidueAncilla L))
   180	
   181	/-- The correlated seed-fiber lift preserves normalization of the strategy
   182	state. -/
   183	theorem seedFiberLiftedState_norm
   184	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   185	    ‖seedFiberLiftedState S L‖ = 1 := by
   186	  rw [seedFiberLiftedState, reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq,
   187	    S.ψ_norm, seedResidueAncilla_norm, one_mul]
   188	
   189	/-! ## From the seed-indexed game to the direct game -/
   190	
   191	/-- The seed-indexed question selected in one residue block of a direct
   192	question.  Applying `ldCL` ensures that irrelevant ambient coordinates are
   193	canonicalized exactly as in the source game. -/
   194	noncomputable def seededLdQuestion (L : LdParams)
   195	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   196	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : LdQuestion L :=
   197	  (q.1, ldCL L q.1 (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L q.2 residue))
   198	
   199	/-- Dilate a strategy for the seed-indexed low-degree game to the directly
   200	indexed game.  The two local carriers receive correlated copies of the seed
   201	residue, and each measurement is block diagonal in that residue. -/
   202	noncomputable def ldStrategyToDirect (L : LdParams)
   203	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) : Strategy (directLdGame L.toDirectLdParams) where
   204	  ιA := S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)
   205	  ιB := S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m)
   206	  ψ := seedFiberLiftedState S L
   207	  ψ_norm := seedFiberLiftedState_norm S L
   208	  A q := blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
   209	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   210	      (S.A (seededLdQuestion L q residue))
   211	  B q := blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
   212	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   213	      (S.B (seededLdQuestion L q residue))
   214	
   215	/-- Projectivity is preserved by the correlated seed-fiber dilation. -/
   216	theorem ldStrategyToDirect_isProjective (L : LdParams)
   217	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) (hS : S.IsProjective) :
   218	    (ldStrategyToDirect L S).IsProjective := by
   219	  constructor
   220	  · intro q
   221	    apply blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   222	    intro residue
   223	    apply matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
   224	    exact hS.1 (seededLdQuestion L q residue)
   225	  · intro q
   226	    apply blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   227	    intro residue
   228	    apply matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
   229	    exact hS.2 (seededLdQuestion L q residue)
   230	
   231	@[simp] theorem ldStrategyToDirect_A_effect (L : LdParams)
   232	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
   233	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   234	    (answer : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
   235	    ((ldStrategyToDirect L S).A q).effect answer =
   236	      Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
   237	        (S.A (seededLdQuestion L q residue)).effect
   238	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm answer) :=
   239	  rfl
   240	
   241	@[simp] theorem ldStrategyToDirect_B_effect (L : LdParams)
   242	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
   243	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   244	    (answer : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
   245	    ((ldStrategyToDirect L S).B q).effect answer =
   246	      Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
   247	        (S.B (seededLdQuestion L q residue)).effect
   248	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm answer) :=
   249	  rfl
   250	
   251	/-- A direct question reconstructed in a residue block parses back to its
   252	canonical direct form. -/
   253	theorem parse_seededLdQuestion (L : LdParams)
   254	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   255	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   256	    parseLdQuestion L (seededLdQuestion L q residue) =
   257	      (q.1, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams q.1 q.2) := by
   258	  exact parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue L q.1 q.2 residue
   259	
   260	/-- Coordinate formula for the correlated residue lift. -/
   261	theorem seedFiberLiftedState_apply
   262	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
   263	    (i : S.ιA) (j : S.ιB)
   264	    (r s : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   265	    seedFiberLiftedState S L ((i, r), (j, s)) =
   266	      if r = s then
   267	        S.ψ (i, j) * (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹
   268	      else 0 := by
   269	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   270	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   271	  simp [seedFiberLiftedState, reindexState, vecTensor, seedResidueAncilla,
   272	    eprState, prodShuffle]
   273

103	/-! ## The leading index of a direction -/
   104	
   105	/-- The coordinates at which a direct direction vector is nonzero. -/
   106	def directionSupport (D : DirectLdParams) (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   107	    Finset (Fin D.m) :=
   108	  open Classical in
   109	  Finset.univ.filter fun j => v j ≠ 0
   110	
   111	theorem mem_directionSupport (D : DirectLdParams)
   112	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (j : Fin D.m) :
   113	    j ∈ directionSupport D v ↔ v j ≠ 0 := by
   114	  simp [directionSupport]
   115	
   116	/-- The leading index of a direction: the least coordinate at which it is
   117	nonzero, or the last coordinate for the zero direction.  Every coordinate
   118	before the leading index vanishes, so a direction is the prefix projection of
   119	itself at its leading index, and the pair (leading index, direction) is a
   120	canonical direct diagonal sample.  It is the direct index of the sample
   121	whenever the sampled direction is nonzero at the sampled index. -/
   122	noncomputable def directDiagonalIndexOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   123	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) : Fin D.m :=
   124	  open Classical in
   125	  if h : (directionSupport D v).Nonempty then (directionSupport D v).min' h
   126	  else Fin.rev D.firstIndex
   127	
   128	/-- Coordinates before the leading index vanish. -/
   129	theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_prefix_zero (D : DirectLdParams)
   130	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   131	    ∀ j : Fin D.m, j.val < (directDiagonalIndexOf D v).val → v j = 0 := by
   132	  classical
   133	  intro j hj
   134	  by_contra hne
   135	  have hmem : j ∈ directionSupport D v := (mem_directionSupport D v j).mpr hne
   136	  have hnonempty : (directionSupport D v).Nonempty := ⟨j, hmem⟩
   137	  have hle : directDiagonalIndexOf D v ≤ j := by
   138	    unfold directDiagonalIndexOf
   139	    rw [dif_pos hnonempty]
   140	    exact Finset.min'_le _ _ hmem
   141	  exact absurd (Fin.lt_def.mpr hj) (not_lt.mpr hle)
   142	
   143	/-- A direction vanishing before `i` and nonzero at `i` has leading index
   144	`i`. -/
   145	theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_eq (D : DirectLdParams)
   146	    {v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D} {i : Fin D.m}
   147	    (hzero : ∀ j : Fin D.m, j.val < i.val → v j = 0) (hi : v i ≠ 0) :
   148	    directDiagonalIndexOf D v = i := by
   149	  classical
   150	  have hmem : i ∈ directionSupport D v := (mem_directionSupport D v i).mpr hi
   151	  have hnonempty : (directionSupport D v).Nonempty := ⟨i, hmem⟩
   152	  unfold directDiagonalIndexOf
   153	  rw [dif_pos hnonempty]
   154	  apply le_antisymm
   155	  · exact Finset.min'_le _ _ hmem
   156	  · apply Finset.le_min'
   157	    intro j hj
   158	    by_contra hlt
   159	    exact (mem_directionSupport D v j).mp hj
   160	      (hzero j (Fin.lt_def.mp (not_le.mp hlt)))
   161	
   162	/-- The leading index of a prefix-projected direction is the projection index
   163	whenever the direction is nonzero there.  This is the generic direct
   164	diagonal sample: the sampled index is recovered from the projected direction
   165	alone. -/
   166	theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection (D : DirectLdParams)
   167	    (i : Fin D.m) (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (hi : v i ≠ 0) :
   168	    directDiagonalIndexOf D (directPrefixProjection i v) = i := by
   169	  apply directDiagonalIndexOf_eq
   170	  · intro j hj
   171	    simp [directPrefixProjection, hj]
   172	  · simpa [directPrefixProjection] using hi
   173	
   174	/-- Prefix projection at the leading index is the identity. -/
   175	theorem directPrefixProjection_directDiagonalIndexOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   176	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   177	    directPrefixProjection (directDiagonalIndexOf D v) v = v := by
   178	  funext j
   179	  unfold directPrefixProjection
   180	  split_ifs with hj
   181	  · exact (directDiagonalIndexOf_prefix_zero D v j hj).symm
   182	  · rfl

   184	/-! ## Decoding mature points and lines -/

   186	/-- Decode a mature LDT point into the fixed direct scalar field, reversing
   187	the coordinate order. -/
   188	abbrev ldtPointToDirect (D : DirectLdParams) :
   189	    Point D.toLDTParameters → Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D :=
   190	  (directPointEquiv D).symm

   192	/-- The direct canonical axis question represented by a mature axis line.
   193	The mature coordinate index is reversed together with the point
   194	coordinates. -/
   195	noncomputable def directAxisQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   196	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   197	  let u := ldtPointToDirect D line.base
   198	  let i : Fin D.m := Fin.rev line.direction
   199	  let v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D := coordinateDirection i
   200	  (.aline, ⟨lineRepMap v u, i, 0⟩)
   201	
   202	/-- The direct canonical diagonal question represented by a mature diagonal
   203	line.  The decoded direction is kept and the direct index is its leading
   204	index, so the question is the canonical direct question of the direct sample
   205	formed by the decoded base, the leading index, and the decoded direction
   206	(`directDiagonalQuestionOf_eq_directLdMap`). -/
   207	noncomputable def directDiagonalQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   208	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   209	  let u := ldtPointToDirect D line.base
   210	  let v := ldtPointToDirect D line.direction
   211	  (.dline, ⟨lineRepMap v u, directDiagonalIndexOf D v, v⟩)

   213	/-- The direct point question represented by a mature LDT point. -/
   214	noncomputable def directPointQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   215	    (u : Point D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   216	  directLdPointQuestionOf D (ldtPointToDirect D u)

   218	/-- Every transported diagonal question is the canonical direct question of
   219	the direct sample carrying the leading index, hence lies in the support of
   220	the direct diagonal sampler. -/
   221	theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_eq_directLdMap (D : DirectLdParams)
   222	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) :
   223	    directDiagonalQuestionOf D line =
   224	      (.dline, directLdMap D .dline
   225	        ⟨ldtPointToDirect D line.base,
   226	          directDiagonalIndexOf D (ldtPointToDirect D line.direction),
   227	          ldtPointToDirect D line.direction⟩) := by
   228	  unfold directDiagonalQuestionOf directLdMap
   229	  simp only [directPrefixProjection_directDiagonalIndexOf]

   231	/-- The mature diagonal line represented by a direct sample: the encoded
   232	point and the encoded direction. -/
   233	def matureDiagonalLineOf (D : DirectLdParams) (sample : DirectLdSpace D) :
   234	    DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters :=
   235	  { base := directPointEquiv D sample.point
   236	    direction := directPointEquiv D sample.direction }

   238	/-- Round trip on generic direct samples: when the sampled direction is
   239	nonzero at the sampled index, the mature line of the canonical direct
   240	diagonal question transports back to that question, index included. -/

240	diagonal question transports back to that question, index included. -/
   241	theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_matureDiagonalLineOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   242	    (sample : DirectLdSpace D)
   243	    (hgeneric : sample.direction sample.index ≠ 0) :
   244	    directDiagonalQuestionOf D
   245	        (matureDiagonalLineOf D (directLdMap D .dline sample)) =
   246	      (.dline, directLdMap D .dline sample) := by
   247	  cases sample with
   248	  | mk point index direction =>
   249	      unfold directDiagonalQuestionOf matureDiagonalLineOf directLdMap
